name: 07407 · Elmwood Park, NJ
findings: ZIP 07407 (Elmwood Park) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07407 (Elmwood Park) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
